candidates.title: Keep the minimum keyboard reveal?
criteria: Does keyboard navigation reveal a clipped line only as far as needed to make the whole line visible?
candidates.content: Launch the frozen build below. Select a source line around lines 500–600, scroll slightly between line boundaries, then use Down or Shift-Down until the selected line reaches the bottom edge. The selected line should be the bottom fully visible line when scrolling is necessary; an already visible target should stay put. Try Up at the top edge and split/unified view as part of the same minimum-reveal judgment. The destination remains line-aligned. Accept to keep this keyboard reveal, or Reject and describe the desired change in the note. Touchpad behavior was already accepted and is retained. After saving this decision, use Finish and hand back.
